name: Slow Creaky Piano Pedal Press
description:
Slowly depressing the pedal on an old upright piano, the slow tension movement of the brass pedal causes the mechanism to creak as it moves the friction dampers into position. 
You can also hear the faint reverberation from the detuned strings as it reaches the final position.
Creak sounds are always useful.
100+ year old upright piano, microphone placed directly inside. (Sample 3 of 4)

name: Pier Walk Montage
description: This audio is a montage of different seaside sounds which try to recreate the feeling of walking along a wooden pier. With just a few sounds, the listener can hear their own steps across the pier, as well as some seagulls begging for fish, a passing fishing boat and the voices of the crew, as well as the constant breaking of waves on the nearby shore. The sounds used are: -Own recording of steps on creaking wood. -Ocean waves Ale stenar 1.wav by Owl -- https://freesound.org/s/195293/ -- License: Attribution 4.0 (constant soft rumbling of waves, which typically move from left ot right). -Seagulls.wav by sinewave1kHz -- https://freesound.org/s/202996/ -- License: Creative Commons 0 (nearby group of seagulls) -Fishing boat engine by LuisDLF -- https://freesound.org/s/755179/ -- License: Creative Commons 0 (strong rumbling of fishing boat engine and fishermen voices)

name: G27-08-Movie Boat Creak Scene.wav
description: Windy and female and male dialogue on a small creaking wooden boat. Water splashing. Could be on a rowboat.  Must be from a movie or television show.

name: Loud Slow Squeaks
description: A bunch of long, slow creaking sounds.  I made these by slowly moving PVC pipes around in unglued joints.  Great loud slow creaking and groaning sounds that would be nice for a haunted house or maybe an old wooden boat at sea.  My students are doing a Foley project for a movie scene, so that's why I made this.  Thought some of you might be able to use it.

name: Wood creaking (wooden chair)
description: This is the sound my wooden chair makes when i go back and forth! This sound is very useful and it can be used in several occasions. For example this could be the sound an old wooden boat cruising on the sea. Use your imagination! Enjoy!
